_note: Approved suppliers catalog. Keyed by supplier slug. Each entry carries the install contract (id, search_url, type) plus scraping config.

aliexpress.label: AliExpress
aliexpress.notes: Slow delivery to UK. Pass only with strong demand (>=30 sold/30d).

amazon_uk.label: Amazon UK
amazon_uk.disabled_reason: Amazon cannot be a source for this tool as of 2026-10. Three independent blockers: (1) PA-API 5 is DEPRECATED and returns 403 AccessDeniedException - the successor Creators API uses OAuth2 and different endpoints, so amazon_api.py targeted a dead path; (2) access now requires 10 qualifying sales in the trailing 30 days, which cannot be bootstrapped without already selling; (3) the Associates Operating Agreement restricts use of the API for aggregating or analysing product content, which is exactly what this tool does. Health-checked twice: 0 products, ~55s. The browser scraper also returns nothing.
amazon_uk.revisit_if: Amazon publishes a non-restrictive programmatic price feed for the UK market, or the 10-sale gate and licence wording change.
amazon_uk.notes: UK-based. Fast delivery. Higher supplier cost typically.

godropship.label: GoDropship
godropship.disabled_reason: The domain no longer hosts a business. Verified 2026-10-10 with a real browser: https://www.godropship.com renders 'GoDropship.com for sale | Spaceship.com' asking $16,995, with buy/add-to-cart links to spaceship.com and zero product markup. /search returns RemoteDisconnected for every variant including a bare /search. This is not a bot block and no proxy, header or endpoint fix can recover it.
godropship.revisit_if: The company reacquires the domain, or a successor supplier is registered.

joybuy.label: Joybuy UK
joybuy.revisit_if: A Joybuy Dropshipper account exposes a product export or API with full cost prices - that replaces the 20%-priced web route entirely. Until then this entry is a link-out source, not a pricing source.
joybuy.notes: Dropship supplier, 7-21 day delivery. Rows carry a real product URL and the SKU in its path; see price_coverage before trusting it for margin.
joybuy.enabled_reason: Enabled 2026-10-10 WITHOUT scraping it. Joybuy's own site is unreadable by us - /s?k= serves a 'Joybuy Risk Control' interstitial that redirects to /user/risk/pic and hands off to JD's risk handler at cfe.m.jd.com, still served to headless Chromium with playwright-stealth, to ScrapingBee on a datacenter IP (403) and on a premium IP (Risk Control). Six routes, zero results. But we do not need to read the site: Joybuy is absent from Google's SHOPPING index (0 of 80 results across two product queries) and present in its ordinary WEB index (10 of 10 results for a site: pass). scrapers/joybuy_web reads Google's index of Joybuy, so Joybuy's servers are never contacted and there is nothing to block. skip_site_pass is set because the same site: on the SHOPPING engine stalls at 67.0s for zero rows.
joybuy.price_coverage: Low. A price exists only where Google rendered a rich snippet with a price extension - measured 2 of 10 results (20%). Unpriced rows are returned as a link-out with price 0.0 ('not stated') and are skipped by the priced matcher, so they can never look like a free product. A Joybuy Dropshipper account with a real product feed is the route to complete pricing; revisit_if below.
